what_it_does: This chip enables voice commands on always-on IoT devices (like smart watches) that can handle continuous speech over a huge range of volume levels—from whispers to shouting. The key innovation combines automatic gain control (a circuit that normalizes loud and soft voices to similar levels) with a smart neural network that skips unnecessary computations when speech patterns have gaps. The whole system uses only 8.62 microwatts—roughly what a hearing aid consumes—and fits on a single chip with both analog audio processing and digital AI computation.
